title: Shared campaigns can keep more history before the size notice
summary: The dungeon master's notice about a large campaign now appears at 12 MB with archived sessions, up from 5 MB.
items: Downloads, recovery copies, session records and Undo of old entries now read archived sessions one at a time, so campaigns can keep much more history online before the notice recommends Download a copy.
Nothing is ever refused at this size: sessions still end as usual, and the notice is only a reminder to keep a copy.
